steps.caption: Access invitations
steps.narration: Here's how to request access to client accounts and keep track of the invitations.

steps.caption: A pending invitation
steps.narration: Each invitation shows the client's customer ID, the email it went to, and its status: this one is Pending.

steps.caption: Accepted
steps.narration: This one was Accepted. Clients can also decline.

steps.caption: Request client account access
steps.narration: To request more, use Request client account access: one customer ID and email pair per line, up to one thousand clients.

steps.caption: Customer ID, email
steps.narration: Type the customer ID, a comma, and the client's email. One line per client.

steps.caption: Review the list
steps.narration: The review counts the invitations and names the MCC they come from.

steps.caption: What the client receives
steps.narration: Each client gets a Google manager invitation and an email that explains how to accept it.

steps.caption: Confirm invitations and emails
steps.narration: Nothing is sent until you choose Confirm invitations and emails.

steps.caption: Cancel pending
steps.narration: To withdraw one, tick a pending invitation in the list and choose Cancel selected pending invitations.

steps.caption: Poll invitations
steps.narration: Poll invitations asks Google which ones were accepted. It also runs on its schedule.

steps.caption: Menu: Access invitations
steps.narration: Access invitations is in the Agency Ads and LSA menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to request client Google Ads access in bulk | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Access invitations in the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager. You will read the status of each invitation, paste customer ID and email pairs for up to 1,000 clients, preview what each client receives, and see where a pending invitation is cancelled.
